title: OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 debuts at #1 on Voice Arena's Jarvis Bench for naturalness, task effectiveness and 100% task success
headline: OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 tops Jarvis Bench at $0.05 per minute
lede: Builders can now call a full-duplex voice model in the OpenAI API as gpt-live-1.1 at $0.05 per active minute that ranks #1 on Jarvis Bench and hits 100% task completion when delegating to GPT 6.2 Sol Medium.

effects.effect: Validates splitting real-time voice I/O from heavier delegated reasoning models.
Puts live human-rated call Elo and task completion at the center of voice evals.
Sets a new full-duplex voice benchmark for naturalness and task execution.

possibilities.connection: GPT-Live-1.1 handles the phone conversation at $0.05 per active minute, delegates booking work to GPT 6.2 Sol, and the Node SDK's new spend alerts give a typed hook to cap runaway sessions.

appearances.why: Combining #1 naturalness, 100% delegated task success, and transparent $0.05-per-minute pricing crosses a practical threshold for production voice agents.
appearances.limits: Results reflect 2,442 Voice Arena votes on Jarvis Bench and do not prove reliability on custom enterprise tools or noisy telephony.
